name: YONEX Co., Ltd.
summary: YONEX Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells sporting goods in Japan. It offers badminton equipment, such as racquets, shuttlecocks, strings, apparel, shoes, bags, etc.; tennis and soft tennis equipment, including racquets, strings, apparel, shoes, bags, balls, etc.; and golf equipment, such as woods, iron, putters, shafts, apparel, shoes, bags, accessories, etc. The company is also involved in golf course management. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
